plugins.description: OsmO's AI makes real phone calls for you and answers your calls as your AI phone receptionist. Call businesses and helplines, get the summary, transcript and recording; see who called, manage caller rules, VIP and block lists and bookings. Every call is confirmed by you first. Sign in with your phone number; no API key.
